info.name: CareerForge local API
info.description: Session-cookie API examples. On 2026-10-06, separate qa/check-api.cjs checks passed 17 assertions each on H2 and the MySQL profile backed by MariaDB 10.4. This Postman collection has not been executed as test evidence. Mutations change local demo records. Retain Postman's cookie jar. Catalog/dashboard requests capture IDs. Inspect variables before deleting. Registration creates an additional account. Use baseUrl http://localhost:8091 for the MariaDB compatibility instance. Requests only target the selected local application.

request.description: Run Dashboard first. Uses the first missing required skill.
Uses the user-skill association ID returned by Add skill, not the catalog skill ID.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const s = pm.response.json().find(x => x.skill); if (s) pm.collectionVariables.set('roadmapStepId', s.id); }
